page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose virtual server instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, configured with 1 physical core and 2 threads, yielding 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core, and does not include local storage or GPU hardware. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the average tier, supported by hardware features like AVX-512 and AES cryptography extensions. However, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks are categorized as poor, reflecting the limitations of the single physical core architecture. Database operations, Redis SET performance, and software compilation tasks also show weak to poor results.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7se.large offers dedicated CPU resources for entry-level workloads but presents a tradeoff in resource density and multi-threaded throughput. It is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic text processing, single-threaded applications, and low-traffic static web serving. It is not recommended for database hosting, heavy multi-threaded processing, or memory-intensive applications.
